title: Anti-pancreatic lipase and anti-adipogenic effects of 5, 7, 3',4',5' -pentamethoxy and 6, 2',4'-trimethoxy flavone - An In vitro study.
authors: Ahmad, Bilal; Friar, Emily P; Taylor, Emerald; Vohra, Muhammad Sufyan; Serpell, Christopher J; Garrett, Michelle D; Loo, Jason Siau Ee; Fong, Isabel Lim; Wong, Eng Hwa
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估两种黄酮类化合物的抗肥胖作用，涉及胰脂肪酶抑制和脂肪生成基因表达，仅含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: In this study, the anti-obesity effects of 5,7,3',4',5-pentamethoxyflavone (PMF) and 6,2',4'-trimethoxyflavone (TMF) were evaluated through two distinct mechanisms of action: inhibition of crude porcine pancreatic lipase (PL), and inhibition of adipogenesis in 3T3-L1 pre-adipocytes. Both flavones show dose dependent, competitive inhibition of PL activity. Molecular docking studies revealed binding of the flavones to the active site of PL. In 3T3-L1 adipocytes, both flavones reduced the accumulation of lipids and triglycerides. PMF and TMF also lowered the expression of adipogenic and lipogenic genes. They both reduced the expression of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-gamma (PPAR-gamma), CCAAT/enhancer-binding protein alpha and beta (C/EBP alpha and beta), sterol regulatory element-binding protein 1 (SREBF 1), fatty acid synthase (FASN), adipocyte binding protein 2 (aP2), and leptin gene. In addition, these flavones enhanced adiponectin mRNA expression, increased lipolysis and enhanced the expression of lipolytic genes: adipose triglycerides lipase (ATGL), hormone sensitive lipase (HSL) and monoglycerides lipase (MAGL) in mature 3T3-L1 adipocytes. Overall, PMF was seen to be a more potent inhibitor of both PL activity and adipogenesis versus TMF. These results suggest that PMF and TMF possess anti-obesity activities and can be further evaluated for their anti-obesity effects.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过两种不同的作用机制评估了5,7,3',4',5-五甲氧基黄酮（PMF）和6,2',4'-三甲氧基黄酮（TMF）的抗肥胖效果：抑制粗制猪胰脂肪酶（PL）活性，以及抑制3T3-L1前脂肪细胞中的脂肪生成。两种黄酮均表现出剂量依赖性的PL活性竞争性抑制。分子对接研究揭示了黄酮与PL活性位点的结合。在3T3-L1脂肪细胞中，两种黄酮均减少了脂质和甘油三酯的积累。PMF和TMF还降低了脂肪生成和脂质生成基因的表达。它们均降低了过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体-γ（PPAR-gamma）、CCAAT/增强子结合蛋白α和β（C/EBP α和β）、固醇调节元件结合蛋白1（SREBF 1）、脂肪酸合酶（FASN）、脂肪细胞结合蛋白2（aP2）和瘦素基因的表达。此外，这些黄酮增强了脂联素mRNA表达，增加了脂肪分解，并增强了成熟3T3-L1脂肪细胞中脂解基因的表达：脂肪甘油三酯脂肪酶（ATGL）、激素敏感脂肪酶（HSL）和单甘油酯脂肪酶（MAGL）。总体而言，与TMF相比，PMF在抑制PL活性和脂肪生成方面表现出更强的效力。这些结果表明，PMF和TMF具有抗肥胖活性，并可进一步评估其抗肥胖效果。
